title: “Let This Feeling Go”
deck: Original artwork and a poster, in two versions.
client: “Let This Feeling Go,” directed by Andrew De Zen
lede: “Let This Feeling Go” was directed by Andrew De Zen in Los Angeles. Its original artwork and poster paint a woman in thick strokes, in two versions, one yellow and white, one red, the title in hand lettering beside her face.
challenge: “Let This Feeling Go,” directed by Andrew De Zen in Los Angeles, needed original artwork and a poster.
work: The artwork is a portrait of a woman, painted in thick, layered strokes, with the title in hand lettering beside her face.
It comes in two versions: one in yellow and white around her dark hair, and one in red and orange, in profile, with a long white earring.
system: A woman, in thick, layered strokes.
Yellow and white; red and orange.
